market_name: Will no Fed rate cuts happen in 2026?

trade_eligibility.reason: Below minimum expected move or unclear direction.

time_plan.30m: Check whether front-end rate futures (SOFR/Fed funds futures) and the 2y/10y yields are moving in the same hawkish direction, confirming the signal is macro rather than a thin-market blip.
time_plan.1h: Compare TLT price action vs the size of the probability shift; look for confirmation in the dollar (DXY) and equity index futures.
time_plan.2h: Re-examine whether any scheduled macro data (CPI, jobs, Fed speak) explains the move — if so the market was reacting to public info, not leaking it.
time_plan.6h: Assess persistence: has TLT held the move or mean-reverted? Check overnight rates markets.
time_plan.12h: Final read: did duration sell off in line with a hawkish repricing, or did the prediction-market move prove noise?

predictions.reasoning: If the implied probability that the Fed makes NO cuts in 2026 rises sharply, that is a hawkish repricing of the rate path — fewer/no cuts means the front end and the whole curve reprice higher in yield, pushing long-duration Treasury prices down. TLT is a clean, liquid proxy for duration. Note the effect is diffuse: rate-path news is broadly disseminated, so a Polymarket move rarely leads Treasuries by much.

predictions.tradable_instrument_name: Invesco DB US Dollar Index Bullish Fund

trade_eligibility.reason: Below minimum expected move or unclear direction.

time_plan.30m: Check DXY and EURUSD for confirmation alongside the rate-futures move.
time_plan.1h: Verify the dollar move is rate-driven, not risk-off flight (which could coincide).
time_plan.2h: Scan for scheduled Fed communication or data that already explains the shift.
time_plan.6h: Assess whether the dollar strength persists or fades intraday.
time_plan.12h: Final read on whether dollar tracked the hawkish repricing.

predictions.reasoning: A hawkish shift (higher probability of no 2026 cuts) generally supports the dollar via wider real-rate and carry differentials. UUP is a liquid dollar proxy. The exposure is weaker and noisier than for duration, and dollar moves depend heavily on relative central-bank expectations abroad.

evidence_used: Market question probability on 'no Fed rate cuts in 2026' — a rise implies a hawkish rate-path repricing
Standard macro transmission: fewer cuts => higher yields => lower long-duration bond prices and stronger USD
Liquidity of TLT and UUP as broad proxies for duration and the dollar
uncertainty_notes: The 700bps tradable threshold is enormous (7%); realistic 12h moves in these liquid proxies are tens of bps, so none of these are 'tradable' under the stated bar.
Fed-path expectations are heavily driven by public data (CPI, NFP, Fed speak); a prediction market is unlikely to lead these liquid assets.
Direction depends on which way the implied probability moved — this card assumes a hawkish (probability-up) shift.

llm_justification.summary: A sharp increase in the implied probability that the Fed makes NO rate cuts in 2026 represents a hawkish repricing of the policy path. The cleanest downstream implications are lower long-duration Treasury prices (TLT down) and a modestly stronger dollar (UUP up). However, rate-path expectations are dominated by widely-disseminated public data, the proxies respond to many other forces, and realistic 12h magnitudes (tens of bps) fall far below the 700bps tradable threshold — so this is a low-confidence, non-tradable research mapping.
key_assumptions: The observed prediction-market move is toward higher probability of no cuts (hawkish).
No offsetting risk-off flow that would push Treasuries up as a safe haven.
The move reflects new information rather than thin-market noise.
failure_modes: The probability could have moved the other way (dovish), reversing all directions.
Rate expectations are already fully public; the market is a lagging, not leading, sensor.
Safe-haven demand could push Treasuries UP even in a hawkish scenario, breaking the TLT link.
Dollar exposure is weak and dominated by foreign central-bank expectations.
Thin prediction-market liquidity can produce probability swings unrelated to genuine information.
llm_justification.why_not_ex_post: The card is timestamped, content-hashed, and never overwritten. Execution must reject any card created after an anomaly's trigger time.
